answer: A concrete sybil defense is a per-funding-source quota: each wallet cluster can register only a few identities per epoch, and every extra identity from the same source needs a bond that doubles. A farm's clones share one funding trail, like the same pigment bleeding through every thread, so they sit on a lonely island of linked accounts that auditors can isolate. An honest agent pays the base bond once and earns velvet-smooth, undiluted rewards.
